feeds.title: Redeemer Church London Blog
feeds.description: Redeemer comprises people who love Jesus, love London, and love Ealing. Join us on the journey, as we explore how this plays out, practically and spiritually, in daily life. Head to our blog to read more about our church, session, daily updates, and more.

feeds.title: The Church of the Redeemer Baltimore Blog
feeds.description: The Redeemer Church in Baltimore, Maryland, is a Christian church that aims to help people know, love, and serve God. Their mission is to proclaim the gospel of Jesus Christ and to make disciples who will share in that mission. They believe in the authority of the Bible as the inspired word of God and seek to follow its teachings in all aspects of life. They have a blog featuring information about their church and all of their activities.

feeds.title: Redeemer Church of Denton Blog
feeds.description: Redeemer Church is a Christian church located in Denton, Texas, USA. Redeemer Church holds to traditional Christian beliefs, including the authority of the Bible as the word of God, the doctrine of the Trinity, and the belief in salvation through faith in Jesus Christ. To learn more about our church and our principles, read our informative articles.

feeds.title: First Redeemer Church Blog
feeds.description: First Redeemer Church's soul purpose is to Worship God and have everyone know and follow Jesus Christ. Our mission is to win, baptize, teach and disciple every person possible by every means possible until the coming again of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. Their blog content includes announcements about upcoming events and activities at the church.

feeds.title: Our Redeemer's Lutheran Ballard Blog
feeds.description: Our blog is a great place to hear musings from Pastor Kathy, ministry leaders and folks in our community. A Community in the Model of Christ. In the model of Christ, and for the life of the world, we are an inclusive, devoted, caring, spiritual community that accepts challenges, takes risks and grows.

feeds.title: Redeemer Lutheran Church GB Blog
feeds.description: A meeting for consultation on organizing a mission was held at Ansgar Hall, Broadway, and Mason Street, in Green Bay. Ansgar Hall was a well-patronized social center and community hall for the influx of Danish settlers to the area. The building, located at 618 South Broadway, was razed in 1956. They also have a Redeemer Lutheran Church GB Blog that provides all the necessary information about the church and its events.

feeds.title: Redeemer Church Manchester Blog
feeds.description: Our blog is updated regularly with thoughts, opinions, and musings that the people of Redeemer have about faith and the world around us. Our vision is to spark a movement for Jesus in Chorlton. To do that, we are joining God to bring wholeness to Manchester. We long to see Manchester filled with communities of light, surrendering to Jesus' words and living them out as a family.

feeds.title: Redeemer Presbyterian Church
feeds.description: Redeemer was planted in 2008 through the Southwest Church Planting Network of the PCA (Presbyterian Church in America). A weekly Bible study with four families grew into a larger group who gathered to dream and pray and embrace a vision for a new church. Follow their Redeemer Presbyterian Church blog and read more about how the church conducts it's sessiosna dnthe changes they re trying to bring in people.

feeds.title: Redeemer Church Manvel
feeds.description: At Redeemer Church, we believe that Jesus Changes Everything! Therefore, our church is centered in our mission to follow Jesus, lead others to Jesus and change the world. We are a community of people who love God, care about families, believe in developing and growing friendships around faith, and have a desire to make a real difference in our community. To learn more about our events, gathering, beliefs, preaching and more, follow our blog.

feeds.title: Redeemer Covenant Church Blog
feeds.description: Whether you are just starting your search for a relationship with God or want to grow in your faith in Jesus, we are delighted that you are here. You are our special guest, and we extend a warm welcome to you! Read our Redeemer Covenant Church Blog for thoughts, insights, and reflections on a variety of topics related to the Christian faith and church life.

feeds.title: Our Redeemer Lutheran Church of San Diego Blog
feeds.description: We are a Bible based congregation and share the Good News that God so loved the world that He gave His only Son Jesus Christ that whoever believes in Him shall not perish, but have eternal life. Follow Our Redeemer Lutheran Church of San Diego Blog and read about the church, the latest news, updates, our teachings, beliefs and more informative articles.

feeds.title: Redeemer Church PV Blog
feeds.description: Redeemer Church exists to reach people with the life-giving message of the gospel so that they might become fully devoted followers of Jesus. If you want to know more about the activities of the church, and get more information about the book of James then head to their blog.

feeds.title: Redeemer Church RC Blog
feeds.description: Read Redeemer Church RC Blog and learn more about the church, their teaching, the messages they want to give to their followers, about religion, workshop and more informative related articles. Redeemer Church is a gospel-centered church composed of people of diverse ages and backgrounds who gather every Sunday morning at Highview Learning Center in Fate for worship.

feeds.title: Redeemer Bible Church Pastor Tim's Blog
feeds.description: Equipping and preparing everyday believers of all backgrounds to be agents of blessing and change in the Church, the community, and the culture. Pastor Tim is known for expository, verse-by-verse teaching of the Scripture.

feeds.title: Redeemer Church PCA Blog
feeds.description: Redeemer Church celebrated its first public worship service on Sunday, January 8th, 2017. We are a member congregation of the Presbyterian Church in America. We espouse, teach and preach from God's Word in accordance with the doctrinal standards set forth in the Westminster Confession of Faith. Our Redeemer Church PCA Blog will provide you with all the necessary information about church and community.

feeds.title: Redeemer Bible Church Blog
feeds.description: This is the official church blog of Redeemer Bible Church in Minnetonka, MN. We are sinners who have been rescued from sin by Jesus Christ. Though we have different backgrounds, ethnicities, opinions, and personalities, we find commonality in the good news of the gospel of Jesus Christ. They have a official church blog providing the latest updates and useful articles about the church.

feeds.title: Redeemer Fellowship NJ Blog
feeds.description: We gather together for Sunday worship at 10AM and scatter throughout ocean county, meeting in homes throughout the week. Redeemer Fellowship NJ Blog provides you with daily church news, updates, informative helpful articles and more.

feeds.title: Redeemer Christian Church Blog
feeds.description: The mission of Redeemer Christian Church is the same mission Jesus gave his followers: Go therefore and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit. The vision of the Redeemer Christian Church is to create a community of authentic believers and to witness a city transformed by the life-changing reality of the gospel, as people come to know Jesus as their lord and savior. Head to their church blog and learn more about their preachings, prayers, the church, and their community events.

feeds.title: Redeemer East Harlem Church Blog
feeds.description: Blog posts from various authors at Redeemer East Harlem about faith, spirituality, and humanity. Redeemer is a family of churches and ministries seeking to serve the city socially and spiritually. From exploring timeless virtues to nurturing a more profound connection with the divine, these illuminating words aim to be a beacon of guidance.

feeds.title: Redeemer Bible Church SJ Blog
feeds.description: We exist to exalt christ by making disciples in this neighborhood, this city, and this world. Therefore, Redeemer Bible Church will be governed and guided by the person and work of Jesus Christ. We will preach with Christ as the central theme of all of Scripture. We will teach that Christ is the supreme goal of all things and has first place in all things. If you want to know more about us, our church, and the latest happenings round the church, head straight to our blog.

feeds.title: Redeemer OPC Blog
feeds.description: Redeemer belongs to the Orthodox Presbyterian Church. The denomination strives, 'to bring glory to God through our churches and individual lives and to make known to the world the good news of salvation through Jesus Christ'. Their blog posts cover a range of topics related to Christian faith and practice, including Bible study, theology, worship, and evangelism.

feeds.title: Blueberry Fiddle Pastor's Blog
feeds.description: Blueberry Fiddle Pastor's has been Transforming Lives through God's Grace for Authentic Living. Their blog shares articles about their church activities and events along with some informative articles on bible, worship and mroe.

feeds.title: Redeemer WV Blog
feeds.description: For no matter how Many promises god has made, they are 'yes' in christ. And so through him 'amen' is spoken by us to the Glory of god. We are a community seeking to connect with each other, grow together in our faith, and go out into our community and world to serve others. Along with serving in our community, our commission is to offer the hope and Good News of Jesus Christ through our gifts, resources, and blog post.

feeds.title: Redeemer Starkville Blog
feeds.description: Belonging to God as his treasured possession and so that our joy might be full, we are sent to proclaim the excellencies of Jesus Christ through the scriptures, good works, and our fellowship, so that all may be conformed into the image of the Son of God and that we might share in the increase of his kingdom on the earth. Know more about our church, latest news, feature stories, and informative articles on our church blog.

feeds.title: Our Redeemer Lutheran Church Prospect Heights Blog
feeds.description: Our Redeemer is a congregation of the Lutheran Church Missouri Synod. As a congregation of disciples, followers of Jesus, we strive to grow spiritually and physically that we might be more and more like Jesus in our love and service to God, one another and our neighbor in need. As followers of Jesus, we teach and confess that which Jesus accepted, preached and taught. Read our blog to learn more about our teachings, worshiping, spiritual topics and more.

feeds.title: Redeemer Baptist Church Blog
feeds.description: At Redeemer Baptist Church, we seek to worship God in biblical simplicity, to serve our community by meeting tangible needs, to communicate the gospel to those who have not heard, to make mature disciples of every believer, and to have Christ at the center of all we do. To know more about the church, our preaching, events, follow our church blog.

feeds.title: Redeemer Community Church
feeds.description: Since this church began meeting in 1998, our vision has been to see lives transformed by the power of the gospel to the glory of God. Here's what we focus on doing: Christ-centered WORSHIP. Worship means drawing near to God in prayer and praise. We also have a blog that covers all the information regarding our church, our belief and the activities.

feeds.title: Redeemer Little Rock Blog
feeds.description: In early February 2008, a group of individuals and families met to consider joining one another to begin a new church in Little Rock. This group shared a common vision for a church where people dig deep into the timeless truth of the Bible. Follow their blog to learn more about the church, community, events, and more.

feeds.title: Redeemer Church Pace Blog
feeds.description: Redeemer Church's Mission is to Bring glory to God through the transforming of lives through the Gospel of Jesus Christ. Redeemer values strong Biblical doctrine, loving outreach, and a genuine Christian community. We strive to be a church where the sovereignty of God and the responsibility of man are embraced and celebrated. Redeemer strongly values both world missions and local missions! If want to know more about the church and our preachings and our work then follow our church blog.
